newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential ups Xerox target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential ups Xerox target.

text.p: -- Prudential analyst B. Alexander Henderson said he boosted his share target price on Xerox Corp to $68 from $62 and that his earnings estimates were "under review" in light of its "better than expected" fourth quarter earnings report.

-- He said he believed Xerox was close to selling two additional Talagen insurance units, after the company said earlier that it had a deal to sell its Coregis insurance unit for $450 million to General Electric Co's GE Capital.
-- Referring to the fourth quarter earnings report, Henderson said that, "Clearly the numbers came in better than expected."

-- The company reported operating earnings of $1.17 per fully diluted share versus $1.03 per share in the year ago quarter, excluding a tax gain and restructuring charges. The First Call consensus estimate had been $1.14 per share.
-- He described the 10 percent dividend hike announced in the earnings report as coming sooner-than-expected.
-- "They are now establishing a trend line," he said, referring to annual dividend increases the company has made in recent years.
-- That should entice 'value players" who bought the stock after its third quarter earnings disappointment to stick with the stock, he argued.
-- Henderson has maintained a strong buy on the stock for several years.
-- Xerox shares had gained 2-1/2 to 60-5/8 by mid-morning Thursday.
